status: PREDECLARED before training candidates B/C/D. This is a small, closed, validation-only architecture-capacity comparison -- not an open-ended hyperparameter search. Everything except hidden_size/latent_size is frozen identically to the approved baseline (see frozen_settings below).

A.label: existing baseline -- already trained, MUST NOT be retrained

C.label: stronger bottleneck with same hidden size

scoring.rule: window_score = mean((x - reconstruction)^2) across all 30x55 elements

threshold_rule.rule: validation-only; same deterministic candidate-generation procedure (percentile grid of pre-fault validation scores, 50.0-100.0 step 0.1); selected threshold = smallest candidate whose pooled pre-fault FPR <= 0.05
threshold_rule.note: The threshold rule itself is NOT altered to chase detection delay for any candidate.

frozen_settings.architecture_variable: hidden_size and latent_size ONLY. num_layers=1 and dropout=0.0 for all four candidates -- architecture capacity is the sole experimental variable.

model_selection_rule.eligibility: a candidate is eligible only if validation F1 >= 0.82 AND validation median detection delay <= 10s AND validation pre-fault FPR <= 0.05
model_selection_rule.note: Uses validation data only. If no candidate is eligible, stop and report -- do not invent another architecture or inspect test data.
